title: A host can price a ticket all-in so guests cover the card fee

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19, pricing decision card: guest covers the card fee is the seller's choice; tickets show one all-in price from the first screen (project thread: Rethink our take rates). ADR-1978.

detail: Once CARD_FEE_PASS_THROUGH_FROM is set, the ticket tier editor offers one tap to reprice a fixed ticket at allInPriceCents(price) (lib/billing/processing-fee.ts), the smallest price that leaves the host what they typed after card processing. The all-in figure is the ticket's price, so every screen shows it and no fee is added at checkout. No stored flag, no schema change. The opt-in box for other sales is a separate row.

verify.note: Fails while the tier editor has no all-in helper or the price math leaves the host short.
